import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List of source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_11/test_0.csv"
        # Add more source files here if available
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from each source
    dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Read the source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Select only the columns needed for the target
        df_selected = df[['sex', 'births']]

        dfs.append(df_selected)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Aggregate births by sex
    target_df = combined_df.groupby('sex', as_index=False)['births'].sum()

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_11/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
